title: Coupon
description: A discount a customer has to present by code. Third level of the lineage base-record → discount → coupon.

source.description: Union tag distinguishing a presented coupon from an automatic promo.

code.description: The code as printed. Unambiguous alphabet: no 0, O, 1 or I.

campaign-id.description: Campaign that funds this coupon, so a redemption can be charged to a budget.

issued-to.description: Account the code was issued to, opaque here. Absent for a bearer code anyone may use.

expires-at.description: First instant the code is refused. Exclusive, matching a promo window.

redemption-limit.description: How many times this code may be burnt in total. 1 for a single-use code.

redeemed-count.description: Times already burnt. Advanced only by coupon-service, under a row lock.
